thread:
harper: short question  for settings forms do we keep the red asterisk or switch to an explicit 'Required' label? thinking about screen readers and localization.
joan: explicit 'Required' label. asterisk is too ambiguous and translators prefer explicit tokens.
lee: agree but keep it visually subtle so it doesn't compete with the primary label. low-contrast gray that still meets 3:1.
a11y-bot: automated scan: 4 fields fail contrast at #bdbdbd. recommend #7a7a7a for 14px text.
harper: noted. do we append 'Required' or place it inline (after label)?
joan: after label reads better in LTR and works for i18n. prefix can be awkward in some scripts.
lee: validation cadence: blur vs submit vs keystroke? we should avoid noisy per-keystroke aria announcements.
harper: blur for most fields, live for confirmations (password match) only. show password rules but avoid live error counts that reveal policy gradations.
dev-bot: implementation note: hybrid pattern. Inline errors on blur, plus top summary on submit that lists errors with anchor links to each field. anchor click should focus field without abrupt scrolling.
lee: focus management snippet: ```js
const f = document.querySelector('.first-error');
if (f) { f.focus({preventScroll: true}); if (!prefersReducedMotion) f.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center'}); }
```
jaon: minor typo — prefersReducedMotion var comes from media query, devs will wire that.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: inline errors should be in DOM and use role="alert" when revealed; top summary should be a list of links with clear names and visible focus outlines. modal dialogs must trap focus and set aria-modal="true".
harper: destructive flow: delete workspace. typed-confirm vs undo?
joan: workspace delete = typed-confirm (require exact name) + server-side soft-delete retention (7 days) by default. offer org setting to relax to undo toast.
lee: also add audit logging and admin permission gating. copy suggestion: header: "Permanently delete workspace" body: "Type the workspace name to confirm. This will remove all data and cannot be undone during the retention window." primary CTA: "Delete workspace" (destructive).
harper: last accessibility nit: ensure typed input inside modal is labelled programmatically and focus is moved to it on open. screen readers should announce that typed confirmation is required.
joan: i'll produce compact + expanded specs (visual tokens, copy, a11y notes) and a small prototype. thanks all! :white_check_mark:
